title: Dry Hills
wikitext:
{{Stub}}[[Image:The Dry Hills.jpg|thumb|The Dry Hills]]

The '''Dry Hills''' are located in the far northwestern corner of the [[Barrens]]. Despite their name, the Dry Hills are actually one of the greener areas of the Barrens because the seeds from nearby [[Ashenvale Forest]] have been carried on the wind over the crags.

These foothills of the [[Stonetalon Mountains]] to the west are primarily populated by [[Witchwing]] [[harpies]] who have recently been raiding caravans traveling the northern [[Gold Road]]. However, the large number of [[zhevra]]s, [[plainstrider]]s, [[raptor]]s, and other game in this [[region]] has drawn many hunters to this area.
